additional_info.subject: ID0435980-DC/Si-D/FR-[MP / P6 170000689] Power converter out of order CRM:00315002783
additional_info.body:
Dear Colleagues,
Mr. Yacine raised a ticket regarding a E17 in PowerConverter. Please check on-site what's wrong, the easiest way is to:
Swap this converter with the neighbour converter (example, swap TB14 with TB15 -> all cables and position)
If it works, then likely a cable problem
If it doesn't work
​​​​​​​Is the problem persisting in the same converter?
​​​​​​​Yes -> replace converter
No -> cable issue
​​​​​​​
Please take a spare converter to site.
